title: fix(agent): treat model_context_window_exceeded as a length finish reason

files.patch:
@@ -505,6 +505,7 @@ func TestIsLengthFinishReason(t *testing.T) {
 	assert.True(t, isLengthFinishReason("length"))
 	assert.True(t, isLengthFinishReason("max_tokens"))
 	assert.True(t, isLengthFinishReason("MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS"))
+	assert.True(t, isLengthFinishReason("model_context_window_exceeded"))
 	assert.False(t, isLengthFinishReason("stop"))
 	assert.False(t, isLengthFinishReason("tool_calls"))
 }

@@ -527,7 +527,7 @@ func mapStopReason(reason string, toolCalls int, incomplete bool) string {
 	switch {
 	case incomplete, reason == "":
 		return types.FinishReasonIncomplete
-	case reason == "max_tokens":
+	case reason == "max_tokens", reason == "model_context_window_exceeded":
 		return "length"
 	case reason == "tool_use" || (toolCalls > 0 && reason == "end_turn"):
 		return "tool_calls"
